Corollary
[entropy rigidity] Source: chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-ii:page-0357 ↗ thm:chow-ii-ch16-complete-heat-harnack ↗ thm:chow-ii-ch16-linear-entropy-formula 1. ch16:16.31\group Entropy Rigidity

If $\operatorname {Rc}\ge 0$ and $\mathcal W_{ m lin}(f, au _0)\ge 0$ for the heat kernel at some $ au _0>0$, then $(M,g)$ is isometric to $\mathbb R^n$.
Proof

\sketch The two preceding results force $ abla ^2f=(2 au )^{-1}g$ for $0< au \le au _0$. Thus $\phi =4 au f$ satisfies $ abla ^2\phi =2g$; its minimum is a pole and $\phi -\min \phi =d^2$. Hence $\Delta d^2=2n$, and equality in Bishop–Gromov comparison gives Euclidean space.

□
